name: ci_failure_routing
question: What should the developer do next about this CI failure?

descriptions.inspect_runner: Inspect the job runner and its setup logs.
descriptions.triage_existing_failure: Follow up on the failure already affecting the default branch.
descriptions.investigate_change: Investigate the proposed change for a reproducible regression.
descriptions.rerun_test: Run the failed test again to see whether the failure repeats.
